extensions.rampMethod: Generated OKLCH preview ramps preserve the source hue/chroma with stepped lightness; transparent colors use their base pigment. Ramps are previews, not additional production theme tokens.

settings.scope: Settings only; code-led extension of the current neutral workbench. Existing global primitives, narrative, components, and review metadata are preserved.
settings.theme: Inherit the active light/dark surface, text, border, fill, and accent custom properties from app.css. The Settings shell aliases tertiary text to secondary text for readable labels, icons, counts, and metadata. Status colors accompany explicit text.
settings.navigation: Grouped sidebar destinations cover workbench preferences, engine installation, Provider/model configuration, and session policy. Active buttons expose aria-current=page; collapsed navigation retains accessible names. Mobile presents horizontally scrolling section pills and the existing bottom navigation.
settings.disclosure: Native details/summary engine rows show identity, current route, and written availability before expansion. Installation, compatible Provider routing, history, and native file/capability information remain progressively disclosed. Inline status and alert text describes progress and failures.
settings.routing: Save the engine's Provider and compatible endpoint in Settings, then select its model in the conversation. Provider save imports models automatically and failed discovery exposes retry. Preserve native login/configuration, saved Provider routes, advanced fixed-model mappings, and independent Kodo/pi configuration identities.
settings.metadata: Expose model limit, capability, and USD-per-million-token price sources. Manual override takes precedence over current endpoint, then public catalog. Blank inputs use automatic values, and zero is an explicit free price.
settings.responsive: At maximum 760px, engine fields and native details stack, Provider headings/actions wrap, and preference selects fill the row. Installation actions, engine route saves, and Provider form actions use minimum 44px height; mobile section pills retain 34px height.
settings.motion: Use existing navigation/section spring tokens and honor both system reduced motion and the saved application preference. The system query removes animation/transitions; the application preference reduces durations to 0.01ms and restores automatic scrolling.
settings.guidance: ../DESIGN.md: Settings-specific Colors, Typography, Layout, Elevation & Depth, Shapes, Components, and Do's and Don'ts sections.

sessionManagement.description:
The existing detail pane presents supervision relations as linked rows with textual mode/state and adjacent pause/revoke actions. Supervisor sessions also show eligible projects and their current authorization state. Three explicit actions distinguish creation permission (仅授权创建), creation with automatic continuation (创建并自动继续), and revocation of future permission (撤销未来授权). The explanatory copy states that automatic control applies only to sessions subsequently created by this supervisor, inherits the goal and limits entered above, and treats blank limits as unset. Existing or paused sessions require separate enablement; revoking future authorization leaves existing per-target relations intact.

When automatic-continuation mode selects a target with another active controller, the form replaces its submit label with an explicit transfer action (转交自动控制). Adjacent explanatory copy states that transfer pauses the former controller, invalidates its unsent input, and lets the current native turn continue. These controls reuse ordinary fields, secondary buttons, muted explanatory copy, and relationship rows; they introduce no new visual tokens or elevation pattern.

narrative.overview:
Kodo uses the user's pinned Craft Agents baseline: quiet neutral surfaces, compact navigation and session metadata, a generous conversation column, and restrained green actions. The interface supports repeated operational work. Hierarchy comes from placement, readable text, tonal separation, and small line icons rather than decorative imagery.

The app presents its own Kodo name and plain K mark. Craft Agents supplies selected semantic tokens and the adapted nine-cell loading indicator at revision `1627c43e93bb4f5b1532116b8eb092c0ada4b23f`; the shell and message presentation are local implementations. The retained LICENSE, NOTICE, TRADEMARK.md, extraction inventory, and brand boundary remain authoritative in [EXTRACTION.md](../../third-party/craft-agents/EXTRACTION.md). Code provenance does not authorize Craft product branding.

This document records the built light theme from `src/styles/craft-tokens.css`, its overrides in `src/styles/app.css`, and the React components. The source also contains a dark-theme toggle and dark roles; the reviewed evidence covers the light theme. The final [verdict](../../.impeccable/review/verdict.md) scored four listed fixes resolved with disposition `ship` for those fixes only; it does not certify the complete product or independently verify runtime capabilities.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral navigator, paper content surfaces, and subtle boundaries.
Green primary actions and keyboard focus with text-backed runtime status.
System UI typography and a spacious, bounded reading column.
Desktop scope, session list, and conversation; mobile list-to-conversation navigation.
Folded tool output, explicit native interactions, and an adjacent stop-and-pause control.

rules.name: The Pinned Baseline Rule
rules.body: Extend the Craft-derived surface hierarchy and Kodo's green action language while preserving the recorded license and brand boundary.

rules.name: The State Has Words Rule
rules.body: Pair runtime color with an explicit state label; color alone must not carry running, waiting, disconnected, or paused meaning.

rules.name: The Native Type Rule
rules.body: Use the shared system stack throughout; keep mobile message and form entry text large enough to avoid zoom (16px).

rules.name: The Reading Space Rule
rules.body: Let the conversation absorb remaining width while keeping prose bounded; show detail and raw history only when requested.

rules.name: The Structural Depth Rule
rules.body: Use elevation for an input surface or an actual overlay, and preserve the quiet tonal separation of the main panes.

rules.name: The Visible Focus Rule
rules.body: Every keyboard entry point retains visible focus; textarea focus must illuminate the composer boundary.

dos: **Do** preserve the pinned Craft-derived neutral surface hierarchy and Kodo green primary actions.
**Do** keep project scope visible and harness identity available through labels and filters.
**Do** label runtime, connection, and supervision states separately and pair status color with words.
**Do** keep a visible composer focus boundary, mobile entry text at 16px, and the reviewed mobile action targets at 44px minimum.
**Do** keep long output collapsible and readable, with raw lifecycle history available separately.
**Do** honor reduced motion and the operating system's font and window conventions.
donts: **Don't** reuse Craft names, logos, domains, identifiers, or service endpoints as Kodo branding.
**Don't** fill empty states with fabricated sessions, replies, verification results, or capability claims.
**Don't** imply a pending send is completed execution, or equate installation discovery with verified protocol behavior.
**Don't** copy the legacy non-tool user-message and reasoning classifications into tool cards.
**Don't** turn optional details into permanent extra panes on a narrow screen.
